Customs Act 1967 [ Act 235], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Customs Duties (Goods under the Regional

Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement) (Amendment) Order 2023.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 March 2023.

Partnership Agreement) Order 2022 [P.U. (A) 64/2022], which is referred to as

the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended—

2017 [P.U. (A) 5/2017]" the words "Customs Duties Order 2022

[P.U. (A) 114/2022]"; and

(b) in subparagraph 3(4), by substituting for the words "Customs Duties Order

2017" the words "Customs Duties Order 2022".

Amendment of paragraph 6

3. Paragraph 6 of the principal Order is amended by substituting for the words

"Customs Duties Order 2017" the words "Customs Duties Order 2022".
